source.section: PDF page 7 'Examples of Income You DO NOT Report' (interest on U.S. and Alabama obligations); PDF page 21 Schedule B instructions; PDF page 23 Schedule D; Form 40 (25f40blk.pdf page 1) lines 5b to 18; booklet PDF page 8 lines 5 to 13, PDF page 10 lines 14 and 17; PDF page 9 Standard Deduction chart (line 11, PDF page 8); Form 40 page 1 boxes 1 to 4 (personal exemption, line 13); tax table PDF pages 25 to 30

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 40,000.00 + U.S. Treasury interest 3,000.00 + dividends 1,000.00 + long-term gains 4,000.00 = 48,000.00 (municipal interest is not in federal AGI). Federal taxable income = 48,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 32,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Alabama: the projection starts from federal AGI and removes exempt income (Form 40 builds its own lines 5b to 10, which give the same AGI for this household except as noted below). U.S. Treasury interest 3,000.00 stays in: the form exempts interest on U.S. obligations (PDF page 7; Schedule B instructions PDF page 21), but the projection cannot tell it from other interest and taxes it (not_modelled, approximation); on the form AL AGI would be 47,000.00, line 16 43,000.00 and tax 2,110.00. Dividends 1,000.00 and long-term gain 4,000.00 stay in: taxable in full (Form 40 line 6; Schedule D, PDF page 23 'the entire gain is taxable'). Add other-state municipal bond interest 2,000.00: taxable in Alabama, only Alabama and U.S. obligations are exempt (Schedule B instructions, PDF page 21; projection muni_interest other_states_taxed_own_exempt); reported on Form 40 line 6. Form 40 line 10 Alabama AGI = 50,000.00. Line 11 standard deduction (single, chart PDF page 9): AL AGI 50,000.00 is over 35,499.00, the band 35,500.00 and above, so 2,500.00. Line 12 federal income tax deduction: the form subtracts the 2025 federal income tax (worksheet PDF page 31); the projection does not model it (not_modelled, approximation), so 0.00 here. Line 13 personal exemption (single) 1,500.00. Line 14 dependent exemption 0.00 (no dependents). Line 15 total deductions = 2,500.00 + 0.00 + 1,500.00 + 0.00 = 4,000.00. Line 16 taxable income = 50,000.00 - 4,000.00 = 46,000.00. Line 17 tax from the derived single / married filing separately / head of family schedule (2% from 0, 4% from 500, 5% from 3,000): (500.00 - 0.00) x 0.02 = 10.00 + (3,000.00 - 500.00) x 0.04 = 100.00 + (46,000.00 - 3,000.00) x 0.05 = 2,150.00 = 2,260.00; the tax table row 46,000-46,100 (single / married filing separately / head of family column, PDF pages 25 to 30) gives 2,263. Line 18 net tax due, no credits: 2,260.00.
accepted_approximations: The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).

The brackets are derived from the tax table. Under 100,000 the table taxes each 100-dollar row at its midpoint, rounded; above 100,000 the printed worksheet ((income - 100,000) x .05 + 4,958, or + 4,918 joint) is 2 dollars below the derived brackets.
Interest on U.S. obligations is taxed (the projection cannot tell it from other interest).
